crossRefs.note: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.
By faith, Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful…

translations.web: The woman conceived and bore a son. When she saw that he was a fine child, she hid him three months.
translations.bsb: and she conceived and gave birth to a son. When she saw that he was a beautiful child, she hid him for three months.
translations.kjv: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child, she hid him three months.
translations.asv: And the woman conceived, and bare a son: and when she saw him that he was a goodly child, she hid him three months.
